blocks.raw: ## Revoke a promotion
blocks.text: Revoke a promotion

blocks.raw:
This release allows an org to revoke certain promotions that have already been issued to customers.\
With this release, an org can now revoke a loyalty earning or reward promotion for a particular customer and also revoke an earn instance(s) of a particular promotion.
blocks.text: This release allows an org to revoke certain promotions that have already been issued to customers.With this release, an org can now revoke a loyalty earning or reward promotion for a particular customer and also revoke an earn instance(s) of a particular promotion.

blocks.raw: API
blocks.text: API

blocks.raw:
* To revoke a promotion(s) for a customer, pass the customerID and promotionID.
* To revoke an earn instance, pass the earnID along with customerID and promotionID.

blocks.raw: ## Nested sorting logic in cart promotions
blocks.text: Nested sorting logic in cart promotions

blocks.raw: Brands were restricted to choose between expiry first or best discount strategy. Now they can decide the primary and secondary parameters for sorting among the two options available.
blocks.text: Brands were restricted to choose between expiry first or best discount strategy. Now they can decide the primary and secondary parameters for sorting among the two options available.

blocks.raw: The promo engine allows brands to set the sorting logic used to decide which promotions to apply if there are multiple promotions applicable on products or carts. Brands could either sort them by Earliest expiry (a promotion that expires first) or Maximum discount, (promotion with the highest benefit).
blocks.text: The promo engine allows brands to set the sorting logic used to decide which promotions to apply if there are multiple promotions applicable on products or carts. blocks.raw: ## Multiple Language Support
blocks.text: Multiple Language Support

blocks.raw:
**Problem Statement**\
Earlier, brands could display their content on the website and mobile app only in English, which was not understood by people from regions of the world.
blocks.text: Problem StatementEarlier, brands could display their content on the website and mobile app only in English, which was not understood by people from regions of the world.

blocks.raw:
**Solution**\
We supported English as the base language for any configuration or meta around entities, but now we have extended the support to add multiple languages through this feature.
blocks.text: SolutionWe supported English as the base language for any configuration or meta around entities, but now we have extended the support to add multiple languages through this feature.

blocks.raw: **Scope of the feature**
blocks.text: Scope of the feature

blocks.raw:
* **Cart promotions**: Standard or custom fields of offers created using Cart Promotions.
* **Store**: Store-related fields.
blocks.text: Cart promotions: Standard or custom fields of offers created using Cart Promotions.Store: Store-related fields.

blocks.raw: ## Message Delivery Status
blocks.text: Message Delivery Status

blocks.raw:
**Problem Statement**\
When an org sends out a campaign message, the org used to receive a delivery report on whether the message was successfully sent or not after 12-24 hours. But customers needed an immediate response. This delay issue contributed to 30%-40% of the gateway issues.
blocks.text: Problem StatementWhen an org sends out a campaign message, the org used to receive a delivery report on whether the message was successfully sent or not after 12-24 hours. But customers needed an immediate response. This delay issue contributed to 30%-40% of the gateway issues.

blocks.raw:
**Solution**\
You can now see the time taken to update the delivery report on the Campaign's Message listing page. In case the delivery rate is not updated even after 12-24 hours, you can raise a ticket. For more details, click [here.](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/message-delivery-status)
